regions.merged_text: Paralisis Cured (4.45 A.M. Sept. 7th) Veronica Rose 19, only child, of Albert Rose, Boston Boulivard, paralized now about two yrs. and on her back most of that time recently in considerable pain - is enrolled To-day 2nd time perpetually. Promises are made in her b- half of more frequent Communion - and gift in Honor of little Fl. St. Terese if Veronica be spared.

regions.merged_text: Insanity Cured Dr. Davis, insane drug-fiend, hopelessly dying in Dearborne Asylum and enrolled eight days ago, Oct 3rd for four years -- at the time of enrollment refused absolutely to have the Priest. This evening reported as reconciled to God, and cured. Thanks be to God!

regions.merged_text: Blind Consumptive resumes teaching her Music Class. Deo Gr! ( de- ferred since Apr. 11st Sister M. Immaculate 42 of Chatham Ontario, formerly consumptive not in refectory since November and now go- ing blind is enrolled April 13th --- April 21st comes in person "Ventured out almost against their will" and reads without diffi- culty three days after enrollment. Thanks to God Same Sister Mary Imaculata resumes her music teaching three days later Apr. 24 what she had been unable and forbidden by doctors to do before. The June Exam's in 192c "most successful."
